description: This file defines a Java interface 'SudoCommandResponse' which extends several other interfaces related to command responses in the Ditto framework, specifically for sudo command responses. It includes methods for setting entity and headers, and defines a nested class for JSON field definitions relevant to the response.

classes.name: SudoCommandResponse
classes.description: A parameterized interface representing responses to Sudo commands within the Ditto framework, providing methods to handle entity data and headers, and encapsulating JSON schema fields.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer, indicating the resource path is not used for SudoCommandResponses.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string for Sudo commands.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity JsonValue for the response.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for the response.
